requirements.text: Add rate limiting to the login endpoint of this Express API.
Create a reusable rate-limit middleware factory for additional endpoints.
Apply rate limiting only to the login route.
Return HTTP 429 with Retry-After and JSON when the limit is exceeded.
Identify clients by IP address.
Install express-rate-limit.
Configure the login route with the stated defaults.
Use the default in-memory store.
Avoid modifying existing route handlers or business logic.
Apply rate limiting only to the login route, not globally or to other routes unless asked.
Use the default in-memory store (no Redis or external dependencies).
Do not modify existing route handlers or business logic.
Keep the code minimal — no comments beyond what's necessary to explain non-obvious lines.
Do not apply rate limiting globally.
Do not apply rate limiting to other routes unless asked.
Do not use Redis or external dependencies for rate-limit storage.
Do not add rate limiting to additional endpoints now; only make the factory reusable for later.
Middleware factory file exporting a rate-limit factory configured with custom 429 handling.
Login route wiring that applies the factory with windowMs 900000 and max 5.
Project dependency configuration adding express-rate-limit.
